name: leapware-tokenwise
description: LEAPWare's own single-plugin marketplace. Hosts tokenwise, a token-policy layer that makes an AI coding session's spend rules mechanical.

plugins.name: tokenwise
plugins.description: A token-policy layer that makes an AI coding session's spend rules mechanical. Ships one walking-skeleton rule, budget_line, gating subagent dispatch on a stated token budget. Policy is per-rule off/warn/deny and fails open. See plugins/claude/tokenwise/.claude-plugin/plugin.json for the full description.
